description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model (FedHLM) framework. The chart is divided into three segments: a large green segment labeled “LOCAL,” which accounts for 94.5% of the distribution; a smaller red segment labeled “LLM,” representing 3.9%; and the smallest blue segment labeled “EDGE_P2P,” comprising 1.6%. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the “LOCAL” segment dominating the chart and the “EDGE_P2P” segment appearing as a narrow wedge. The percentages are clearly labeled within or adjacent to each slice, and the chart uses a simple color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling. This distribution suggests that the vast majority of token routing occurs locally, with minimal routing to LLMs or peer-to-peer edge nodes, reflecting the system’s design for communication efficiency as described in the paper.
